items.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024
items.q: So the original thing was, it was two saxophones. It was me with Kenny Garrett.

ctx.x: So yeah, that was like extraordinary of course, one of the most extraordinary moments of my life just to have that happen. And of course the tape was good and I had to be able to deliver, but it was also a case of who you know. Because if it wasn’t for Matt being in New York at that time and knowing that Miles was in the studio and like all the coincidences that had to happen for that to happen was pretty amazing. So the original thing was, it was two saxophones. It was me with Kenny Garrett. And I had seen that…

Marriott on Central Park South, which is where Miles was living, and got to his door and it said “Please take off your shoes.” So I was standing there with my horn and my shoes for about 15 minutes, and I finally got the courage to knock on the door. And he opened the door with a smile on his face and he brought me in and I was totally at ease. It was really, really an extraordinary moment.
